Josh Barkin is the creator of Tipcast.
The project was based in Toronto, Canada.
The funding for Tipcast was canceled by the project creator on November 29, 2013.

fact_previews: Tipcast is a platform designed to share developing stories.
Josh Barkin is the creator of Tipcast and has experience building mobile apps.
Josh Barkin's team has previously built reward apps for AT&T, Sprint, and Virgin Mobile USA/Canada.
The team has focused on iPhone apps more recently.
The team built a prototype of Tipcast but acknowledges that much work remains.

The team expresses gratitude to those who can help make Tipcast a platform for sharing progress.
The team has worked hard to understand their technical limitations through prototypes and iterations over the past year.
The team is confident that feedback and actual usage data will guide their decisions.
The team is determined to build a product that they can use for their own projects as well as for others.
